intendedUse: Permit the report to be relied on as the organisation's approved professional deliverable for an external submission under its own approval policy.
workflowBoundary: Evidence is gathered; the report is drafted; technical content is reviewed; required approval authority is confirmed; the authorised signatory accepts the report; the approved version is submitted.
workflowCompletion: The report is complete when technical acceptance criteria pass and the organisation's required approval/signatory authority is evidenced for the submitted version.
movedBottleneck: Fast drafting shifts the constraint to evidence quality, assurance, version control, and confirmation that the person approving the work has the required organisational authority.
unhappyPath: A knowledgeable reviewer says the report looks technically sound, but the record does not show that this reviewer is authorised to approve the external deliverable or that the reviewed version is the submitted version.

actors.role: Draft the report from supplied evidence.
Perform technical review of the draft.

assurance: Technical review against the named criteria
authority: The technical reviewer is authorised to comment on quality, but the current record does not establish the separate approval/signatory authority required by the organisation's submission policy.
accountability: The organisation's deliverable owner is accountable for confirming both technical acceptance and the required approval authority before external reliance.
demonstrated: The draft was reviewed for technical content and no material technical error was recorded in the review note.
inferredOrAssumed: The phrase 'a human reviewed it' was initially treated as if it also proved approval authority and submission readiness. Those are separate claims.
knownLimitations: Approval/signatory authority for the reviewed version is not evidenced.
The version-control link between the reviewed draft and the proposed submitted version is incomplete.
acceptanceCriteria: Technical criteria are reviewed against the named evidence.
Material claims are traceable to approved evidence.
The required organisational approver/signatory is identified and authorised.
The approved version is the version released externally.
nextEvidence: Provide the approval/signatory authority record, bind it to the reviewed version, and confirm that all Deliverable acceptance criteria are met for the external submission.
stopRule: Keep the report in draft/review status. Do not equate technical review with organisational or legal authority to release the deliverable.
